deep.reconstruction:
CONTEXT (from the next page). Gauss is following the roots of a trinomial-type equation of degree 7, x^7 + 28 x^4 = C, as the right-hand side C moves along a path ('Zug'). The next page treats the 'last Zug', C = 280 + 681.52985 cos(phi) +/- 651.52373 i sin(phi). There log 681.52985 = 2.8334849, log 651.52373 = 2.8139302, and 7 log 28 = 10.1301062. On this page C is fixed, with log10|C| = 2.5337214, so |C| ≈ 341.8. The argument gamma = arg C ≈ 214°59'11.1''. This follows from the angle constant used below and from the sum of root arguments. Hence C ≈ -280.0 - 196.05 i. The page computes the last two roots, VI and VII, and then checks all seven roots by products.

METHOD (my modern restatement). Write x = r e^{i theta} and C = |C| e^{i gamma]. Put psi = 4 theta - gamma + 180°, so that psi + 3 theta = 7 theta - gamma + 180°.
- Imaginary part of x^7 + 28 x^4 = |C| e^{i gamma} after dividing by e^{i gamma}: r^7 sin(7theta-gamma) + 28 r^4 sin(4theta-gamma) = 0. This gives r^3 = -28 sin(psi)/sin(psi+3theta) (in magnitude 28|sin psi|/|sin(psi+3theta)|).
- Real part: |C| = 28 r^4 sin(3theta)/sin(psi+3theta) (up to sign).
- Eliminating r gives the condition on theta alone: sin^7(psi+3theta) / (sin^3(3theta) sin^4(psi)) = 28^7/|C|^3. In logarithms: 7 log sin(psi+3theta) - 3 log sin 3theta - 4 log sin psi = 7 log 28 - 3 log|C| = 10.1301062 - 7.6011642 = 2.5289420.
- Once theta is known: r^7 = |C| sin(psi)/sin(3theta) (absolute values).

ROOT VI.
- Trial theta0 = 7°46'18''. Then 3theta0 = 23°18'54''. psi0 = 356°6'0.911'' (the constant 180° - gamma = 325°0'48.911'' added to 4theta0 = 31°5'12''). psi0 + 3theta0 = 19°24'54.911''.
- With x = correction to theta in arcseconds, Gauss tabulates log sin 3theta = 9.5974604 + 146x, log sin psi = 8.8325785 - 1236x, log sin(psi+3theta) = 9.5216770 + 418x. The coefficients are 3, 4 and 7 times the tabular differences of log sin per second.
- Cubing, fourth power and seventh power give: 3·9.5974604 → 8.7923812 + 438x; 4·8.8325785 → 5.3303140 - 4944x. Their sum is 4.1226952 - 4506x. Also 7·9.5216770 → 6.6517390 + 2926x.
- The difference is 2.5290438 + 7432x, to be set equal to 2.5289420. The discrepancy is -1018, so x = -1018/7432 = -0.137''. The corrected root argument is theta = 7°46'17.863'' (the heading shows the overwritten seconds).
- log(sin psi/sin 3theta) = 9.2351181 - 1382x. Correction +189 gives 9.2351370.
- Adding log|C| = 2.5337214 gives log r^7 = 1.7688584, so log r = 0.2526941.
- log cos theta = 9.9959925 and log sin theta = 9.1310569. Hence x_VI = 1.7729098 + 0.2419641 i.

ROOT VII.
- Trial theta0 = 177°26'12''. Then 3theta0 ≡ 172°18'36''. psi0 = 314°45'36.911'' (again 4theta0 + 325°0'48.911''). psi0 + 3theta0 ≡ 127°4'12.911''.
- Logs: 9.1264990 - 468x, 9.8512947 - 83x, 9.9019468 - 111x.
- Powers: 7.3794970 - 1404x and 9.4051788 - 332x, with sum 6.7846758 - 1736x. Also 9.3136276 - 777x.
- Difference: 2.5289518 + 959x. Discrepancy -98, so x = -0.102'' and theta = 177°26'11.898''.
- log(sin psi/sin 3theta) = 0.7247957 + 385x, corrected to 0.7247918.
- Adding 2.5337214 gives 3.2585132, so log r = 0.4655019.
- log cos theta = 9.9995652 (negative) and log sin theta = 8.6505424. Hence x_VII = -2.9178779 + 0.1306304 i.

CHECK TABLE. All seven roots are listed (arguments and log moduli):
- 7°46'17.863'', 0.2526941
- 11°40'32.379'', 0.2974961
- 59°12'35.573'', 0.4982805
- 95°16'38.479'', 0.2757765
- 101°0'59.451'', 0.2583573
- 122°35'56.008'', 0.4856196
- 177°26'11.898'', 0.4655019

Since the product of the roots of x^7 + 28x^4 - C equals C:
- The arguments sum to 574°59'11.651'' ≡ 214°59'11.651'', which agrees with gamma ≈ 214°59'11.09'' to about 0.6''.
- The log moduli sum to 2.5337260, against log|C| = 2.5337214 (46 units in the 7th place).

The 'n' marks on roots 2, 4 and 6 and on the sum are not explained on this page.
errors: No real errors in the arithmetic for roots VI and VII. Every logarithmic power, sum, differential coefficient and correction checks to the last place.

The control sums show small residuals, consistent with 7-place work. The product of moduli is off by 46 units in the 7th decimal (2.5337260 vs 2.5337214). The sum of arguments is off by about 0.56'' from the value implied by the angle constant 325°0'48.911''.
The 'n' marks in the summary table (roots 2, 4, 6 and the total) have no evident meaning as negative-number signs, since the logs are of positive moduli. Their meaning is unclear from this page.

results.what: Numerical solution of the trinomial equation x^7 + 28x^4 = C with complex C. The equation is split into an angle condition sin^7(psi+3theta)/(sin^3 3theta sin^4 psi) = 28^7/|C|^3, solved by trial angle plus linear (secant/Newton) correction in log-sine tables. The modulus then follows from r^7 = |C| sin psi / sin 3theta.
results.modern_name: Polar-form / logarithmic-trigonometric solution of trinomial equations (with Newton-type linear interpolation)
results.usually_credited_to: Gauss (Beiträge zur Theorie der algebraischen Gleichungen, 1849, Part II on trinomial equations, with real coefficients)

results.what: Verification of all seven computed roots via Vieta: the sum of arguments ≡ arg C and the sum of log moduli = log|C|.
results.modern_name: Vieta's product relation used as a numerical check

results.what: Tracking the roots of a polynomial along a path of the constant term C (the 'Zug' of the roots; continuation context from the next page).
results.modern_name: Root continuation / root loci of a one-parameter polynomial family (homotopy-continuation-like tracking)
results.usually_credited_to: Implicit in Gauss's FTA proofs (1799, 1849); systematic root loci later (Evans 1948); numerical continuation in the 20th century

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a careful numerical computation of two roots of a complex-coefficient trinomial equation, using Gauss's own published 1849 technique for trinomials, plus a Vieta check. Applying it to complex C and tracking roots along a path is a nice unpublished detail but methodologically routine for him.

checkable.asserts: The target 7 log 28 - 3 log|C| equals 2.5289420 (the 7 log 28 here is 10.1301062).
The angle condition at the trial root VI gives 2.5290438, i.e. 1018 units above the target 2.5289420.
The correction is x ≈ -0.137 arcsec, giving theta_VI = 7°46'17.863''.
Root VII gives the same C as root VI.
The sum of the seven log moduli is 2.5337260 (≈ log|C| = 2.5337214).
The sum of the arguments ≡ 214.98657°, i.e. 214°59'11.651'' = arg C.
